implemented: Actual page annotations in an effective native/frozen PDF2 graph require AP, except simultaneous zero width and height, Popup, Projection or Link.
Projection annotations with either zero width or zero height prohibit AP, even though a nondegenerate Projection may provide one (12.5.6.24, physical page520).
AP is a dictionary with N; N/R/D are actual Form XObject streams or state dictionaries. Null optional entries retain absence semantics.
Any N/R/D state dictionary requires a name AS; an unmatched AS remains representable under the consumer fallback expressly permitted on physical page491.
Appearance streams have Form subtype, optional Type XObject, optional FormType1, numeric BBox and optional numeric Matrix; their graph context remains the actual current or retained revision.
Cumulative appearance/state traversal is explicitly bounded. No private key-name scan is used.
notClaimed: No implicit appearance generation, event execution or rollover/down rasterization.
PDF1.7 AP absence retains its previous behavior. Existing managed WidgetAnnotation selection remains its explicit construction contract.
